title: Pricing the Late Charge on an Employer-Liable Shortfall Notice
content:
## The notice priced

Under the Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement, the late charge priced here is the one on the employer-liable shortfall notice booked most recently on the agreement, when it is the only employer-liable notice booked that day and the only employer-liable notice on the deduction schedule it concerns, and that schedule carries no remittance return; in any other case nothing is booked under this pricing.

## Open amount

The open amount of the shortfall notice is the open amount of the deduction schedule it concerns: the schedule amount less the remittances and write-offs pointing to that schedule, plus the remittance returns pointing to it, as the records stand on the day the charge is booked.

## Charge

The late charge on the shortfall notice is the greater of the tier's minimum late charge and the percentage charge, which is the rate of the tier's late charge rate percent applied to that open amount and rounded half up to the cent.

## De minimis amount

A late charge is booked on a shortfall notice only where the notice has an open amount of at least the de minimis amount of 25.00 US dollars; a notice with a smaller open amount carries no late charge and no line is booked for it.

## Order of the figures

For a shortfall notice the employer is liable for, the figures are applied in one fixed order: percentage points added to the rate are added to it first, the rate so formed is applied to the open amount and rounded half up to the cent, and the way the late charge is worked out from that percentage charge is then applied.

## Worked figures (hypothetical Professional-tier program: rate 1.5 percent, minimum 35.00)

| Schedule amount | Remittances and write-offs on it | Open amount | Percentage charge | Late charge |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 9100.00 | 860.00 | 8240.00 | 123.60 | 123.60 |
| 5300.00 | 3500.00 | 1800.00 | 27.00 | 35.00 |
| 4120.00 | 4100.00 | 20.00 | none | none: below the de minimis amount of 25.00 |
